description: This file defines a static class 'CreateEndpoint' that provides an API endpoint for creating or updating content items in OrchardCore CMS. It includes route setup, authorization checks, content validation, merging, creation, updating, publishing, and error handling.

classes.name: CreateEndpoint
classes.description: A static class providing an API endpoint for creating and updating content items, including route registration and request handling.

methods.name: AddCreateContentEndpoint
methods.description: Registers the POST API route 'api/content' for creating content items.

methods.name: HandleAsync
methods.description: Handles the creation or update of a content item, including authorization, validation, merging, and publishing or saving drafts.

methods.name: AddValidationErrorsToModelState
methods.description: Adds validation errors from ContentValidateResult to the ModelState for error reporting.
